svg.title: fountain 模块依赖矩阵 / Module dependency matrix
svg.text: fountain 模块依赖矩阵 / Module dependency matrix
行 = 依赖方，列 = 被依赖方；两轴同一顺序（按依赖层级：基础层在左上）⇒ 依赖只落在对角线右上侧
Rows are dependents, columns are dependencies; both axes share one order (foundation top-left) ⇒ all cells sit above the diagonal
43 个模块 / 234 条直连（结构性 61、冗余直达 173）；实心格 = 结构性依赖，浅色格 = 冗余直达
43 modules / 234 direct dependencies (61 structural, 173 redundant); solid cell = structural, pale cell = redundant
格子颜色 = 依赖方的颜色（与连线图一致）；底行数字 = 被依赖次数；悬停格子显示「依赖方 → 被依赖方」；不含示例应用
Cell color = the dependent's color (same as the diagram); bottom numbers = in-degree; hover a cell for the pair; demo apps excluded
